effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 [Eosmon] and 1 [Menoa Bellucci] among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, by placing this Digimon as 1 of your [Eosmon]'s bottom digivolution card, you may play 1 [Menoa Bellucci] from your hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When another [Eosmon] is played, this Digimon may digivolve into an [Eosmon] in your hand, reducing the digivolution cost reduced by 3.
